newsitem.title: UK: TI Group wins $170 million aerospace deals.
newsitem.headline: TI Group wins $170 million aerospace deals.

text.p: British engineering company TI Group Plc said on Thursday its Dowty aerospace business had won two further contracts worth in excess of $170 million at the Paris Air Show.

The company said Dowty had now secured over $270 million of new business in Paris. In addition, Dowty has been selected by British Aerospace /Airbus to supply the landing gear systems for new Airbus A340-500 and A340-600 aircraft.

TI Group said the business comprised a $100 million contract for Dowty Aerospace to supply the propeller system for Lockheed Martin Alenia Tactical Transport Systems twin-engined tactical transport C-27J Spartan aircraft.
Messier-Dowty, the joint venture between TI Group and Snecma of France, has been awarded a contract worth over $70 million to supply the landing gear for the Fairchild Dornier D0328-300 commuter jet.
